snippet.title: The Kings Bargain Trailer
snippet.description:
The King's Bargain is a gothic RPG-Strategy game that blends immersive storytelling with deep survival and resource management. It thrusts the player into a world shattered by a king's foolish choices, challenging them to survive and ultimately break a kingdom-wide curse.

Genre & Theme
Genres: RPG-Strategy, Survival, Resource Management.

Theme: Gothic, Dark Fantasy, Medieval. The game's narrative revolves around a king's sinful pact and a queen's vengeful curse.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939570/The_Kings_Bargain/
